included_table_columns_signatures: cg-1 children make sense of their surroundings through mathematics using numbers, shapes, and measurements. they develop a sense of quantity and its verbal expression.|||||competency|content|||||class-1|class-2

cg-2 develops fluency with whole numbers expressed as indo-arabic numerals, and the four basic arithmetical operations on them, including number facts and the concept of place value, simple fractions and their comparison.||||||competency|content||||||class-3|class-4|class-5

cg-3 explores and expresses the attributes and qualities of 2d and 3d shapes, describes and depicts spatial relationships and locations, recognises and constructs symmetrical forms.||||||competency|content||||||class-3|class-4|class-5

cg-4 learns to measure attributes such as distance, length, weight, area, capacity and time using both standard and non-standard units, relating measure and number.||||||competency|content||||||class-3|class-4|class-5

cg-5 develops a taste for solving problems posed as puzzles, arithmetical stories and mathematical contexts from everyday life, with opportunities for computational thinking.||||||competency|content||||||class-3|class-4|class-5

statement_type_policy.description: Use for source-visible CG-coded curricular goal table headers, such as 'CG-1 Children make sense of their surroundings...'. These are top-level grouping nodes directly under the StandardsFramework root.

Use for source-visible C-coded competency statements in the left Competency column, such as 'C-2.1 Represents numbers using the place-value system...'. These are grouping nodes under the matching Curricular Goal and parent the class-specific content bullets.

Use for official syllabus content bullets visible in the Class-1 content column. These are leaf learning/content expectations under the current competency. Do not use this label for the Class-1 column header itself.

Use for official syllabus content bullets visible in the Class-2 content column. These are leaf learning/content expectations under the current competency. Do not use this label for the Class-2 column header itself.

Use for official syllabus content bullets visible in the Class-3 content column. These are leaf learning/content expectations under the current competency. Do not use this label for the Class-3 column header itself.

Use for official syllabus content bullets visible in the Class-4 content column. These are leaf learning/content expectations under the current competency. Do not use this label for the Class-4 column header itself.

Use for official syllabus content bullets visible in the Class-5 content column. These are leaf learning/content expectations under the current competency. Do not use this label for the Class-5 column header itself.

as.sfi_extraction_instructions: Extract only the standards-like syllabus content from the Proposed Draft Syllabus tables. Do not extract the introductory rationale, document title/subtitle, TNSCERT/logo text, the 'Proposed Draft Syllabus' section headings, Pedagogical Approaches, or Assessment Strategies as SFIs. The source hierarchy is: Curricular Goal (CG-* table header) -> Competency (C-* first-column statement) -> class-specific content bullets in the Class-* columns. Extract each visible CG-* table header as one Curricular Goal candidate with its source-visible CG code. Extract each visible C-* competency statement as one Competency candidate with its source-visible C code; accept source/OCR variants such as 'C 1.5' as the same code style as 'C-1.5'. For content cells, extract official syllabus content bullets as leaf candidates using the statement_type that matches the source column: Class-1 Content, Class-2 Content, Class-3 Content, Class-4 Content, or Class-5 Content. The Class-* column header is not itself an SFI; it determines the class-specific statement_type for the content beneath it. Do not assign statement_code to class-specific content bullets because no official content-item code is visible. When a content cell contains multiple real bullet points, prefer one SFI candidate per bullet or per coherent bullet item; however, do not split an OCR/layout-broken continuation line into a separate SFI merely because it starts with a bullet marker when it visibly continues the preceding item, such as a broken phrase inside a shape/classification list. Use table filldown or surrounding table context only to understand which competency a continuation row belongs to; do not quote helper-only filldown text as source_text. For table candidates, cite only the visible table header rows and/or body rows that contain the candidate's quoted source_text/description. Do not add inferred parent context, class labels, or paraphrases into description/source_text unless those words are source-visible in the cited rows.
as.sfi_deduplication_instructions: Merge only candidates that represent the same logical source item repeated because of overlapping extraction windows, stitched table continuation, or exact duplicate extraction. Never merge candidates with different statement_type values. Never merge different official CG or C codes. Do not merge class-specific content across different Class-* Content statement types, even if the wording is similar or identical. Do not merge content bullets that appear under different competencies or curricular goals unless the source evidence clearly shows they are the same repeated table item from a continuation/overlap artifact. Treat same text, same table row, same source segment, and duplicate buckets as review signals, not automatic merge rules. Keep separate source items when repeated wording functions as separate class-level or competency-level content.
as.sfi_has_child_instructions: Resolve direct hasChild relationships according to the source table hierarchy. Curricular Goal nodes are direct children of the StandardsFramework root. Competency nodes are direct children of the Curricular Goal whose CG code matches the competency's leading number, for example C-2.3 belongs under CG-2. Class-* Content nodes are direct children of the visible Competency for the same table row or continuation row. Do not create Class-* header nodes, and do not attach Class-* Content directly to a Curricular Goal when the relevant Competency parent is available. Use source-local evidence first: same table row, continuation/filldown context, active outline/source order, same table/source segment/window, and code-parent hints. Use code-parent hints as supporting evidence only; source-visible table context and the configured direct parent policy control the final direct parent. If a child belongs to a continuation row whose Competency cell is blank, choose the nearest preceding active Competency in the same CG table when the table context supports it. Choose the StandardsFramework root only for Curricular Goal items or when no source-supported SFI parent can be selected.

lc.generation_instructions: Decompose each final Tamil Nadu Mathematics Standard SFI into one or more atomic mathematical skills or concepts. Preserve English source meaning and terminology. Do not create activities, examples, or assessment tasks as LearningComponents.
